data.description:
## Description

**What**: Add a NOT-flag rubric section to reviewer-base.md with at least 5 auto-downgrade categories that prevent minor findings from being escalated to "important". Add an override or exemption clause to reviewer-delta-test-quality.md so that anti-pattern detection findings are excluded from the NOT-flag rules. Rebuild all 10 reviewer agent files via build-review-agents.sh.

**Why**: NOT-flag rules close the other side of the severity calibration gap: rather than calibrating what IS important, they proactively block classes of findings that are structurally never important (style preferences, impossible-path error handling, etc.).

**Scope**:
- IN: NOT-flag rubric section in reviewer-base.md; reviewer-delta-test-quality.md exemption clause; rebuild of all 10 agent files
- OUT: Auditing security/performance overlay deltas for NOT-flag exemptions — those deltas have distinct semantics (e.g., "missing error handling for impossible paths" may be reachable via untrusted input in security context) and are deferred to future scope

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, reviewer-base.md contains a NOT-flag rubric section with at least 5 auto-downgrade categories (including "style preference without functional impact" and "missing error handling for impossible paths")
  ← Satisfies: "reviewer-base.md contains a NOT-flag rubric section with 5+ auto-downgrade categories"
- When this story is complete, reviewer-delta-test-quality.md includes an override or exemption clause that explicitly prevents the NOT-flag rubric from applying to anti-pattern detection findings
  ← Satisfies: "The reviewer-delta-test-quality.md delta overrides or exempts this section"
- When this story is complete, all 10 generated reviewer agent files are rebuilt via build-review-agents.sh and each file contains the NOT-flag rubric text inherited from reviewer-base.md
  ← Satisfies: "All 10 generated agent files inherit it via build-review-agents.sh"
- When this story is complete, unit tests are written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Section must use structural pattern (markdown heading + bullet list) compatible with agent-authoring sub-agents (a8e8-0b23 cross-epic)
- [Maintainability] reviewer-base.md will now contain both severity calibration (from S1) and NOT-flag sections — verify both sections coexist without heading anchor conflicts before committing

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a code reviewer agent, I apply NOT-flag auto-downgrade rules to prevent over-escalation of minor findings
